claim.statement: The pinned DINOv3 configuration can produce an allocation-free embedding-forward plan that rejects the real 512/1024 projection before tensor or checkpoint payload work under the existing CPU multiply-add policy.
claim.scope: Shape, output-byte, and patch-projection work accounting only; no RSS/peak-memory, real forward, transformer block, encoder, GPU, or Metal claim.

evidence.result: 4 examples, 0 failures; exact synthetic plan, exact-budget boundary, pinned real-config rejection, and unsupported-edge rejection
3 examples, 0 failures; existing bounded caller regression
fails before checkpoint/payload work: DINOv3 patch projection requires 805306368 multiply-adds, limit is 67108864
fails before checkpoint/payload work: DINOv3 patch projection requires 3221225472 multiply-adds, limit is 67108864
fails at 3,145,727 for a 3,145,728-MAC plan; exact budget passes
fails before plan construction with admitted-resolution error

dod: The plan is allocation-free and reports patch geometry, output elements/bytes, and projection multiply-adds.
The pinned real config rejects 512 and 1024 projection work before opening or decoding a checkpoint payload.
The existing EmbeddingCPU forward consumes the same plan path, avoiding guard drift.
CPU-only DINOv3/TRELLIS.2 suites, no-codegen builds, formatting, and diff checks pass.

excluded: real tensor allocation or input reads in preflight mode
real 1024-wide embedding forward and numerical parity
24 transformer blocks and final norm weights

residual_risks: Multiply-add count is a policy guard and not a measured latency or peak-memory prediction.
The plan accounts for declared F32 payloads but excludes allocator/native/runtime overhead and concurrent callers.
The real checkpoint remains a user-local artifact and its embedding forward remains intentionally unexecuted.
The digest receipt is not a file lock; callers must prevent same-size replacement during role decode.
